title: Inventory and Language
author: Rosalind Joubert
blurb: Zephyrine Blackwood, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
